summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; permits validator-owned successor contexts by replaying valid published/LKG catalog selections against current verified read-set bytes; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes source bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection, current source hashes, snapshot, Locator result, decisions, predecessor; authority envelope covers ADRs, repository rules, policies, contracts, registries, successor kinds; stale freshness/query-quality may degrade unrelated execution only when selection, authority, modules, and read-set verify; publication failure cannot advance current/LKG or invalidate valid LKG; selection, authority, contract, command/test, policy, protected-path, source-integrity, or Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid profile permits degraded same-selection execution but no publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release additionally requires current published Knowledge, publication checks, semantic-review evidence; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop execution interpretation; publication query gate, LKG integrity, authority and source checks remain mandatory
